blocks.intro: On April 17 and 18, 2013, 7.26 inches of rain fell on Elmhurst, and homes old and new were damaged in all areas of town.

items.body: Many of the same neighborhoods flooded both years.
Age alone doesn't protect a basement.
Sewer water and groundwater need different fixes.

bodies: Some basement water is plumbing and some is the foundation. We handle the plumbing side: backflow valves, [overhead sewer systems](/elmhurst/overhead-sewer-systems), [sump pumps](/elmhurst/sump-pumps), battery backups and discharge lines.
If water is coming through cracks in the walls, a waterproofing contractor is the right call, and we'll tell you so.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Stop it, find it, protect it.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: When more than 7 inches of rain fell in April 2013, Elmhurst Patch reported scenes reminiscent of 2010, in the same neighborhoods. That pattern matters. If your block has flooded before, it can flood again, whether your house is from 1955 or 2015. The good news is that the protection is well understood: a reliable sump pump with a backup for groundwater, and a backflow valve or overhead sewer for sewer water.

blocks.h2: Basement Flooding Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Is it sewer water or groundwater?
items.answer: Through the floor drain is usually sewer water. At the walls is groundwater.

items.q: Our basement flooded in 2010 and 2013. What should we do?
items.preview: Find the source and protect against it.
items.answer: Find out whether it was sewer water or groundwater, then add the right protection: an overhead sewer or backflow valve for sewer water, a sump pump with backup for groundwater.

items.q: Do you dry out flooded basements?
items.preview: We fix the cause. Restoration companies dry and clean.
items.answer: We fix the plumbing cause. A restoration company handles drying and cleanup.

items.q: What's the best protection for a finished basement?
items.answer: Usually a reliable sump pump with a battery backup plus an overhead sewer or backflow valve.

items.q: Can you tell where the water came in?
items.answer: Usually. Stains, water lines and where it pooled first all point to the source.

items.q: Do window wells cause basement flooding?
items.answer: They can if they fill with water. Covers and a clear drain at the bottom help.

items.q: How much does basement flooding repair cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the cause and what needs to be repaired or added. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
